48.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, ever a sight for sore eyes! What brings you here this day? Are you come to see our progress, or perhaps to contribute to it?

49.original: In any case, I owe you a debt of gratitude. Thanks to able and willing helpers such as your good self, the reconstruction effort proceeds apace. This court has fairly been reborn, I believe you will agree.

50.original: Oi, Francel. I've finished my checks, and everything looks to be order. That's that for the court, I reckon.

51.original: Glad am I to hear it. This is a momentous step in our project─one we could not have taken without the aid of Ishgardians and outsiders alike.

52.original: Aye. At last, we've got a flow of materials comin' in, along with the hands to put it all to use. It begins in earnest.

53.original: That it does, my friend. That it does.

54.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, Augebert. There is something I would ask of you.

55.original: I bid you commit to your mind's eye the Firmament as it is now.

56.original: When the last paving stone is laid, I would have you fully appreciate how much has been accomplished by the sweat of innumerable brows.

57.original: For though Ishgard may arrive at a brighter future, we must never forget the path we walked to get there, fraught with sorrow and sacrifice as it was.

58.original: If we do so, I fear we will lose our way again.

59.original: Heh, same old Francel, though, eh? Try to unclench that jaw of yours a little, lad, else you're liable to give yourself a fever and collapse like you used to.

60.original: Those days are long past, thank you very much!

61.original: <sigh> Just...remember what I asked. And pray keep it private. 'Tis a personal request to the two of you.

62.original: Don't worry, you know I ain't no gossipmonger. Now then, if there's nothing else, I'll get back to it.

63.original: All right, my friend. Take care you do not overwork yourself, and tell the others the same.

64.original: Well, there you have it, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. There will be a brief hiatus while we prepare for the next phase of construction. When all is in readiness, I shall make another announcement.

65.original: In the meantime, do rest and recover your strength. 'Twas good to see you again.
